variants.headline: Still in view: food shortage leaves the colony hungry
variants.sub: People in the colony are hungry because food is insufficient.
variants.body:
There is not enough food in {colony}, and people are going hungry. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

A wage matters because of the life it helps support. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
